reports.name: AAFC Outlook for Principal Field Crops (Canada)
Statistics Canada Production of Principal Field Crops

outlook: Soybeans led Monday's trade, with January futures closing up 8 cents at $12.28¾ on strength in soybean meal (up $4.70) and a solid pace of soybean shipments, even as soybean oil slipped with a $3 drop in crude oil. December corn finished nearly unchanged at $4.34¼; a strong US dollar at its highest since March 2025 and export commitments running well behind last year's pace kept a lid on prices, with funds estimated net short close to 90,000 contracts ahead of December first notice day on Nov 30. Wheat was mixed: Chicago December rose 2¾ cents to $5.77 and Minneapolis December spring wheat gained 1¾ cents to $6.40, helped by USDA's first announced wheat export sale since June and escalating Black Sea attacks, while Kansas City wheat fell 3¼ cents. ICE January canola eased C$1.00 to C$775.80, and USDA rated 54% of the US winter wheat crop good to excellent.
